entries.name_ja: とらのあな秋葉原店A
entries.note: Toranoana's last Akihabara store, on Chuo-dori next to the former store B. Closed 2022-08-31 together with Shinjuku, Chiba, Namba A and Umeda; only Ikebukuro and Taipei survive, so no Toranoana pin belongs in Akihabara at all. Announced 2022-07-05 as part of the company's retreat from physical retail after COVID.

entries.name_ja: とらのあな秋葉原店B
entries.note: Opened 2006-08 as とらのあな秋葉原本店, renamed store B in 2009; the seven-floor flagship that carried the women's doujinshi floors. Closed 2021-04-06 on lease expiry, women's doujinshi moved to the Ikebukuro store.

entries.name_ja: とらのあな秋葉原店C
entries.note: Opened 2013-11-01 in the Tokyo Kakuta Building (ex-Kakuta Musen / Kakuta Sofmap) facing stores A and B. Closed 2021-04-04 because the building was scheduled for demolition and redevelopment.

entries.name_ja: とらのあな2nd PREMIUM 秋葉原ラジオ会館出張所
entries.name_en: Toranoana 2nd PREMIUM Akihabara Radio Kaikan branch
entries.note: Second-hand / antiquarian branch on 2F of the new Radio Kaikan main building. Closed 2021-02-28; the Radio Kaikan floor guide has not listed it since. Do not re-create it when seeding Radio Kaikan tenants.

entries.name_ja: とらのあな2nd（本店・外神田4-3-7）
entries.note: Used hobby / retro game shop opened by Toranoana in Akihabara; put on indefinite suspension in April 2019 and never reopened, and the chain left Akihabara entirely on 2022-08-31. OSM still carries node/5332501653 (name とらのあな, branch 2nd, shop=books) with a dead website URL (toranoana.jp/shop/toranoanasecond/ returns 404) - this node is the main re-seeding risk. No exact final-day date was published, hence no date field.

entries.name_ja: GiGO秋葉原1号館
entries.note: The red landmark arcade at 外神田1-10-9 on Chuo-dori (ex-SEGA Akihabara No.1), closed 2025-08-31 after 33 years when the fixed-term building lease expired. GENDA GiGO continues with GiGO Akihabara No.2, No.3 and No.5 only. The same building reopened 2025-11-22 as シルクハット秋葉原 (Matahari/Adores), which is the record that should hold this address.

entries.name_ja: GiGO秋葉原4号館（旧クラブセガ秋葉原4号館）
entries.name_en: GiGO Akihabara No.4 (formerly Club SEGA Akihabara No.4)
entries.note: The arcade right outside the Electric Town exit, run as Club SEGA then GiGO. Closed 2022-09-25 after 11 years. OSM still carries node/4553422390 (クラブセガ, branch 秋葉原4号館, leisure=amusement_arcade) - stale, must never be seeded.

entries.name_ja: セガ秋葉原2号館
entries.note: Large arcade in the former Daiichi Kaden building; closed 2020-08-30 after 17 years. The building reopened in April 2023 as GiGO秋葉原2号館 (currently open), so only the retired SEGA name is denied here - GiGO No.2 itself is a live venue.

entries.name_ja: アドアーズ秋葉原店
entries.note: Large multi-floor arcade in a prime Chuo-dori location; the karaoke floor closed 2020-10-31 and the arcade itself on 2020-11-08. Adores' successor presence in Akihabara is シルクハット秋葉原 (opened 2025-11-22 in the ex-GiGO No.1 building), not this site.

entries.name_ja: ボークス秋葉原ホビー天国1（ラジオ会館1号館）
entries.name_en: Volks Akihabara Hobby Tengoku 1 (Radio Kaikan Annex 1)
entries.note: Volks' nine-floor shop in Radio Kaikan Annex 1 closed 2021-05-16 and was absorbed into ボークス秋葉原ホビー天国2 (外神田4-2-10), which had a phased opening from 2020-10-24 and full grand opening 2021-06-05. Successor record: volks-akihabara-hobby-tengoku-2. The annex building later held ダイコクドラッグ秋葉原西口店 and is slated for demolition.

entries.name_ja: あみあみ秋葉原店2nd
entries.note: Used-figure shop in the Akihabara Super Building (神田明神通り); last day of trading 2024-02-29, closed from 2024-03-01 because the building was being rebuilt. Reopened as あみあみ秋葉原フィギュアタワー店 at 外神田1-15-3 (Uniden Akihabara Bldg, 9 floors). Successor record: amiami-akihabara-figure-tower.

entries.name_ja: ACOS秋葉原
entries.note: Animate group's cosplay specialty shop in AKIBAカルチャーズZONE (opened 2014-04-25, moved there from アニメイト秋葉原). Closed 2021-09-20; ACOS has had no Akihabara branch since, so cosplay pins in the building must not be revived.

entries.name_ja: GOOD SMILE×アニメイトカフェ（AKIBAカルチャーズZONE）
entries.name_en: GOOD SMILE x animate Cafe (AKIBA Cultures Zone)
entries.note: Collaboration cafe / showroom run by Good Smile Company and Animate in AKIBAカルチャーズZONE from 2014-04-25 (successor to GOOD SMILE cafe x Karaoke no Tetsujin). Closed 2021-09-20 on the same day as ACOS秋葉原 in the same building.

entries.name_ja: AKIHABARAバックステージpass
entries.note: Idol-training entertainment cafe on 6F of AKIBAカルチャーズZONE (opened 2011-12, home base of idol group バクステ外神田一丁目). Closed 2022-10-10 and converted to iTube Studio, so the ACZ floor guide should not list it.

entries.name_ja: アニメイトAKIBAガールズステーション（後のアニメイト秋葉原別館）
entries.name_en: animate AKIBA Girls Station (later animate Akihabara Annex)
entries.note: Opened 2016-07-16 in Radio Kaikan Annex 2, later renamed アニメイト秋葉原別館; merged into アニメイト秋葉原本館 on 2022-01-16 (pre-orders transferred there from 2022-01-17). The site is now 晴れる屋2秋葉原タワー店.

entries.name_ja: サンコーレアモノショップ秋葉原総本店
entries.note: Thanko's quirky-gadget flagship (opened 2009, 外神田3-6-1) closed 2026-04-12 as the company concentrated on product development and online sales. OSM still carries node/4937999266 (サンコー, shop=toys, Mo-Su 11:00-20:00) - stale.

entries.name_ja: トレーダー秋葉原3号店
entries.note: Closed 2021-11-30 so its building could be rebuilt; the replacement building at 外神田4-2-1 reopened 2024-05-23 as トレーダー秋葉原本店. The name 3号店 is retired - Trader now runs only 本店 and 2号店 in Akihabara. Note OSM way/217379773 is still tagged トレーダー3号店ビル although it is the current 本店 building.

entries.name_ja: トレーダー秋葉原本店（旧店舗・外神田3-14-10 トレーダー本店ビル）
entries.name_en: Trader Akihabara Main Store (old premises, Sotokanda 3-14-10)
entries.note: The Chuo-dori premises stopped trading 2024-05-06 and the building was demolished; the store reopened 2024-05-23 at 外神田4-2-1 (ex-3号店 site). Only the old address is denied - the live record trader-akihabara-honten holds the new one.

entries.name_ja: ROBOTROBOT秋葉原ラジオ会館店
entries.note: Used-toy and figure shop on 5F of Radio Kaikan; closed 2023-02-19. The unit was taken over by magi 秋葉原ラジオ会館店, which opened 2023-03-17.

entries.name_ja: TRIO 秋葉原ラジオ会館店
entries.note: Idol-goods shop on 5F of Radio Kaikan, closed 2024-05-06; らしんばん秋葉原ラジオ会館店 opened over the TRIO and IN-PuLse units on 2024-08-08. OSM still carries node/10136698417 (Trio, shop=second_hand, level 5) - stale. The TRIO chain itself is still active in Akihabara (TRIO DX in AKIBAカルチャーズZONE), so deny only the Radio Kaikan branch.

entries.name_ja: IN・PuLse 秋葉原ラジオ会館店
entries.note: Long-running Radio Kaikan tenant (5F, moved there from Annex 1) that closed 2024-06-30 when the business wound up. Its unit, together with the former TRIO space, became らしんばん秋葉原ラジオ会館店 on 2024-08-08.

entries.name_ja: ANIPLEX+ 秋葉原（アニプレックス オンライン アンテナショップ）
entries.note: Aniplex's antenna shop on 1F of Radio Kaikan closed after trading on 2023-06-18 (official notice on the Aniplex Online site). The unit is now くじ専門店マッハ.

entries.name_ja: BEEP秋葉原店（旧店舗・外神田3-9-8 中栄ビルB1F）
entries.note: The basement retro-game shop near Super Potato ended 10 years of trading on 2026-05-17 ahead of the building's demolition; BEEP reopened 2026-06-06 in SEEKBASE unit 3 (神田練塀町15-1). Only the old basement address is denied - the live record beep-akihabara holds the SEEKBASE location.

entries.name_ja: 私設図書館シャッツキステ
entries.note: Classic-style maid cafe near Suehirocho / Tsumagoizaka, open since 2006. Closure announced 2020-06-24 because of COVID-19 and brought forward to a final day of 2020-11-15, ending 14 years of trading.

entries.name_ja: 大人のデパート エムズ 秋葉原店（ポップライフデパート エムズ）
entries.note: Still trading at 外神田1-15-13 (10:00-23:00), but it is an adults-only (18+) sex-shop department store across all floors, so it is out of scope under the R-18 policy (adult-only venues are not published). OSM node/1915008596 is tagged shop=erotic and sits among the anime shops, so seeding must skip it.

entries.name_ja: 秋葉原ラブメルシー
entries.note: Adults-only (18+) adult-goods store at 外神田1-2-7, open 10:00-22:00 and still trading. OSM way/181065609 is tagged shop=erotic; excluded under the same R-18 policy as M's rather than because it closed.

entries.name_ja: 秋葉原CandyBOX
entries.note: Idol-live event space on 外神田4-6-2 いすゞビル3階 (capacity 100). The space opened 2015-04-17 as the maid cafe 秋葉原MOCHU PIT, closed 2016-12-31, reopened February 2017 as 秋葉原CandyBOX, and closed for good in January 2020; ライブ部 titles the page 秋葉原CandyBOX（閉店）. No exact final day was published, hence no date. E

The official Akihabara site posts a closing notice for the last day of trading, 2022-08-28; the Nagoya shops of the same brand continue, so only the Akihabara branch is denied. entries.name_ja: Maison de ROZE（メゾン・ド・ROZE）
entries.note: Danso (male-costume) cafe & bar on 3F of MTビル, 外神田4-4-7. Its own X account posted on 2025-08-05: 「Maison de ROZEは8月30日をもちまして閉店する運びとなりました」. Sister shop of Maison de Eterna under the same operator.

entries.name_ja: Maison de Eterna（メゾン・ド・エテルナ）
entries.note: Sheep-themed concept cafe & bar opened 2020-10-16 on 3F of MTビル, 外神田4-4-7. Closure inferred, not confirmed by a dated announcement: no official site, TikTok dormant since 2022, akihabara-bc.jp's 2025-04 concept-cafe survey lists it as gone, and its sister shop Maison de ROZE on the same floor closed

entries.name_ja: トレカONE
entries.note: Closed 22 December 2024 (MNビル3F / ガチャポン会館3F). The shop's X account announced the closure on 2024-11-17, ended buyback on 2024-12-15 and ran a closing sale; akibatoreka.com and akihabara-bc.jp now list it as 閉店. カードショップCLIMAX moved into the same 3F unit at the end of May 2025. entries.name_ja: カードショップビームス秋葉原本店
entries.note: Not a closure but a rename: became トレカ専門店トレーディア秋葉原本店 in February 2021 at the same MNビル4F. Deny-list it so the still-current OSM node named 'カードショップ　ビームス' (node/11779681423) is never seeded as a separate shop; it is covered by tradia-akihabara-honten.

entries.name_ja: トレカ横丁 ドン・キホーテ秋葉原店5F

Aniplex's only Akihabara outlet was ANIPLEX+ 秋葉原 (アニプレックス オンライン アンテナショップ) at 外神田1-15-16 秋葉原ラジオ会館1F, which closed after trading on 2023-06-18 per the official notice, and no replacement opened. The official site littletgv.com is STILL LIVE with the old address and hours and no closure notice, and the official X account @littletgv still carries the

entries.name_ja: トレカジャンボ 秋葉原2号店

Gone by October 2025, when エルドラード ポケモン館 took that 2F unit; the shop's X account @torekajumbo2 has been deleted and akihabara-cardmap.com no longer lists it. Exact final day not found, so no dat

Closed 2022-01-16; the unit reopened in September 2022 as 月都「かぐや城」. Still tagged live in OSM as node/5479310977 (amenity=cafe, theme=miko, level=0) — seeding must never r

entries.name_ja: 巫女喫茶 秋葉亭
entries.note: Miko-themed concept cafe at 外神田1-6-1 外神田ビル1F (built into the former 秋葉原神社 fit-out), pre-open 2017-11-16 / grand 2018-02-01. Closed during 2023 — month not published; the successor 巫女茶屋すずなり was already trading in the same torii-fronted unit by 2023-08-29 and closed in 2025-07. Still tagged live in OS

entries.name_ja: 月都 かぐや城
entries.note: Successor of 足湯喫茶 浪漫亭 in the same unit, 外神田1-6-1 外神田ビル1F, opened September 2022. Now marked 閉店 by maidcafe-guide.com; exact date not published. Listed here so the 外神田ビル1F unit's whole concept-cafe lineage stays on the deny-list.

entries.name_ja: 巫女茶屋すずなり
entries.note: Last concept cafe in the 外神田1-6-1 外神田ビル1F unit, successor to 巫女喫茶 秋葉亭 (visited there 2023-08-29). maidcafe-guide.com states 「※2025年７月をもって閉店しました」 — July 2025, exact day not published, so the date given is the end of that month and should be treated as month-precision.

entries.name_ja: Maison de chou chou（アキバあそび館7F）
entries.note: No longer at 東京都千代田区外神田1-6-3 アキバあそび館7F; the 7F unit is occupied by すぽっとらいと (spotlight-akiba.com, active X/Instagram/TikTok/YouTube, 年中無休 17:00-23:00 / 25:00). Last traces are 2019 blog visits. Exact closing date not published. Do not re-seed from OSM node/6331247204.

entries.name_ja: Melty Charm（メルティーチャーム、アキバあそび館4F）
entries.note: Not confirmable as trading under this name. The operator's own dotsweet.jp still lists it at 外神田1-6-3 アキバあそび館4F but has posted nothing since 2021-03-31; the same 4F unit is listed today as .Sweet（ドットスウィート）, and neither name is in ConCafeNavi's current Akihabara list. Do not re-seed from OSM node/633

entries.name_ja: 男装カフェ（アキバあそび館6F）
entries.note: Never a trading name — only the generic descriptor on OSM node/6331247203 (level=5). 6F of アキバあそび館 is LaMule (18:00-23:00, 不定休). Deny-list the OSM node so a 'dansou cafe' pin is not re-created at 外神田1-6-3.

entries.name_ja: アキバあそび館（外神田1-8-8 岡嶋ビル1F〜6F）
entries.note: The original amusement facility of that name, in the Okajima Building at 外神田1-8-8, closed 2011-05-23 ('永らくご愛顧いただきました「アキバあそび館」は5月23日をもちまして閉館いたします'). It is unrelated to the seven-storey concafe building at 外神田1-6-3 that now carries the name, and 1-8-8 岡嶋ビル is today コトブキヤ秋葉原館.

entries.name_ja: Cafe Chales
entries.note: Was mapped at 小暮末広ビル5F (外神田3-15-6). No primary source ever confirmed it; 5F is occupied by the card buyer トレカマサイ, whose official access page gives 小暮末広ビル5階, 13:00-20:00 (不定休), with the move announced on its X account in August 2026. Deny-list so the OSM node is not reseeded.

entries.name_ja: LILIAN PICOLE ラビリント店
entries.note: OSM-only name at 小暮末広ビル2F with no Japanese-source trace. That 2F unit is cafe MENU (collab cafe, opened under this name 2025-12-12) with the PABLO×MENU goods store alongside it. Deny-list so the stale OSM node is not reseeded.

entries.name_ja: メイドカフェ ぴなふぉあ ラビリント店
entries.note: The maid cafe that held 小暮末広ビル2F; the chain's own X account states all shops went 無期限営業休止 after business on Monday 10 October (holiday), and maidcafe-guide marks the ラビリント店 page 【閉店】. Still listed as if open by tabelog, moe-sta and concafenavi, which is what put it into the sweep.

entries.name_ja: Mizuiro days（みずいろでいず）
entries.note: Night concept cafe/bar at 外神田3-16-13 秋葉原FTビル7F. No closure announcement was found, but MOESTA+ lists it as a 閉店店舗, the 7F unit is now listed as MaineCoon『メインクーン』, and there is no recent social activity under the name; treat as gone. Applies to OSM node/11823676908 'mizuiro days'.
